title: 第16章 别拿锤子砸我第17章 大白菜好像要被人连根拔走了
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 瓦丁村的夜路不好走，全是坑。
苏璃深一脚浅一脚地跟在那个叫塞娜的姑娘身后。
他这双不合脚的靴子里塞满了破布条，走起路来像是踩在棉花包上，软绵绵的不着力。
但他没吭声，也没喊累。
这点苦跟上辈子在码头扛大包比起来，那就是挠痒痒。
前面的塞娜走得很急，两条粗壮的麻花辫在背后来回甩动。
她时不时回头看一眼苏璃，确定那个长得跟画儿似的人没跑，也没变成一阵烟飞走，这才放心地继续带路。
那眼神里藏着一种捡到宝贝后的窃喜，还有一种生怕宝贝被人抢走的紧张。
到了村西头一处院子前，塞娜停住了脚。
这是一个典型的铁匠铺。还没进门，苏璃就闻到了一股浓重的铁锈味和焦炭味。
院子里乱七八糟地堆满了废铁料，断掉的犁耙、生锈的马蹄铁，还有一个只有半截身子的铁砧。
塞娜把手指竖在嘴边，做了个噤声的手势。她指了指院子角落里的那个狗窝。
一条大黑狗正趴在那儿睡觉，耳朵贴在地上，时不时抽动两下。
苏璃点了点头。
塞娜轻手轻脚地推开院门。那扇破木门发出“吱呀”一声轻响。
大黑狗猛地抬起头。
那一刻，苏璃浑身的肌肉都绷紧了。他已经在计算逃跑路线了。
如果这狗扑过来，他是往树上爬，还是把塞娜推出去挡枪？好吧，推姑娘挡枪太缺德，还是爬树吧。
“小黑子，趴下。”
塞娜压低声音喝了一句。
那条大黑狗似乎认出了主人的气味，原本竖起来的毛立刻顺了下去。
它摇了摇尾巴，呜咽了一声，重新把脑袋埋进爪子里。
苏璃松了口气。
看来这只狗还算讲道理。
两人像做贼一样穿过院子，进了屋。
屋里很黑，只有灶膛里还留着一点暗红色的火星。空气里弥漫着一股酸菜炖肉的味道，还有老男人身上特有的汗臭味。
呼噜声震天响。
那是从左边那个房间里传出来的。声音大得像是在拉风箱，又像是两块铁皮在互相摩擦。
“那是我爹。”塞娜小声解释道，“他睡得死，打雷都听不见。”
苏璃借着灶膛的微光打量了一下这间屋子。
很简陋。一张粗木桌子，几把只有三条腿的凳子，墙上挂着几把还没打磨好的镰刀。
穷是穷了点，但这屋顶看着挺结实，比那棵漏风的大树强百倍。
content_en:
The road in Wading Village is not easy to walk at night and is full of pits.
Su Li followed the girl named Sena step by step.
His ill-fitting boots were stuffed with rags, and when he walked he felt like he was stepping on cotton bags, which was limp and ineffective.
But he didn't say anything, nor did he cry out.
Compared with carrying big bags at the dock all my life, this pain is just scratching my head.
Sena in front walked very quickly, her two thick braids swinging back and forth behind her back.
She looked back at Su Li from time to time to make sure that the person who looked like a painting did not run away or fly away in a puff of smoke, then she continued to lead the way with peace of mind.
There was a kind of secret joy after finding the treasure in his eyes, and there was also a kind of nervousness for fear that the treasure would be snatched away.
Arriving at a courtyard in the west of the village, Sena stopped.
This is a typical blacksmith shop. Before she even entered, Su Li smelled a strong smell of rust and coke.
The yard was littered with scrap metal, broken rakes, rusty horseshoes, and an anvil with only half its body.
"Shh-"
Senna put her finger up to her mouth, making a silencing gesture. She pointed to the doghouse in the corner of the yard.
A big black dog was sleeping there, with its ears on the ground and twitching from time to time.
Su Li nodded.
Sena gently pushed open the courtyard door. The broken wooden door made a soft "squeak" sound.
The big black dog suddenly raised his head.
At that moment, all the muscles in Su Li's body tensed up. He was already calculating an escape route.
If the dog pounces, will he climb up the tree, or push Senna out of the way to block the gun? Well, pushing the girl to block the gun is too immoral, so let’s climb a tree.
"Little Heizi, get down."
Sena lowered her voice and drank.
The big black dog seemed to recognize the scent of its owner, and the hair that had been standing on end immediately fell down.
It wagged its tail, whimpered, and buried its head in its paws again.
Su Li breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems that this dog is quite reasonable.
The two men crossed the yard and entered the house like thieves.
The room was dark, with only a little dark red spark left in the stove. The air was filled with the smell of pickled cabbage stew and the unique smell of old men's sweat.
The snoring was loud.
It was coming from the room on the left. The sound was as loud as a bellows, and like two pieces of iron sheet rubbing against each other.
"That's my dad." Sena explained in a low voice, "He was so asleep that he couldn't even hear the thunder."
Su Li took advantage of the dim light from the stove to look at the room.
Very crude. There was a rough wooden table, a few stools with only three legs, and a few unpolished sickles hanging on the wall.
I am a bit poor, but this roof looks very strong, a hundred times stronger than that big tree that leaks wind.
"that……"
